tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Roraima catalog of products for sale, such as smart devices, smart locks and installation services, by words in their name or description. Holiday rentals are not included: they come from search_listings.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Public details of one product on sale on Roraima: name, category, description, lowest price among its sellers, maker and model for devices, image and the link to its page. No seller contact details.

tools.name: get_product_link
tools.description: Link to the page of a product on sale on Roraima. The buyer chooses options and quantity, and pays, on that page.
